text:
maria: Heads up — kicking off a targeted access recert this afternoon (1pm PT). Scope: resource owners only + admin roles with no activity in the last 30 days + cross-account KMS bindings. We'll generate 'owner-evidence' tickets rather than auto-revoke. :mag_right:
ashok: Quick Q — tickets only, right? no automatic role removals or key deletions?
maria: Correct, notices/tickets only. Ops will not remove anything without owner confirmation. If ownerless after 7 days we escalate to the oncall rotation for manual action.
jordan: Can we add a live audit query for last-use to the run so we can prioritize by risk? I sketched a BigQuery-style query for audit logs: 
```
SELECT resource.labels.key_name AS key,
       protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS last_actor,
       MAX(timestamp) AS last_use
FROM `org_logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.type = "kms_key"
GROUP BY key, last_actor
ORDER BY last_use ASC
LIMIT 1000;
```
Use that to pick keys with last_use > 30d.
sec-bot: recert-job rc-20260323-01 started at 2026-03-23T13:00:12Z. Collecting owner metadata and KMS grants. Progress updates will be posted here.
sre-oncall: FYI if we blast owners with emails this will spike pager noise for some teams. Recommend throttling owner notifications to 50/hr and adding a header so tools can dedupe.
paul: I can take payments infra owners triage — will handle owner outreach + reassign steps.
ashok: For the KMS bindings, do we include service-account grants used by scheduled jobs? Need to avoid breaking batches.
maria: Yes include service-account grants in the inventory but mark any with recent activity (<7d) as low priority to avoid disruption. We'll surface these with a tag "recent-svc-use".
jordan: Posting a quick smoke-check command for audit coverage (gcloud):
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --project=my-payments --limit 50 --freshness=30d
```
It lists recent decrypts — good to filter safe keys.
paul: +1. I'll coordinate with payment-sre to whitelist anything critical.
maria: Plan update: 1) run now to collect data 2) open evidence tickets to owners 3) wait 7 days 4) escalate ownerless items to oncall for manual remediation. Volunteers: @paul for payments, @jordan for query tuning, @ashok to validate runbook docs.
jordan: Uploaded query tune here: https://gist.internal/r/abc123 and added comments re: timezones and retention.
ashok: I'll update the runbook path to include the KMS smoke tests (/runbooks/access-recert-kms.md) and add a rollback checklist.
sec-bot: recert-job rc-20260323-01 finished collection phase at 2026-03-23T13:09:59Z — 4,312 resources scanned, 98 KMS bindings, 72 potential ownerless alerts.
maria: Nice. Will post the owner-evidence ticket summary tomorrow morning and tag people for triage. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
